summary: AMD's supply-chain disclosure moved from limited-supplier language to a more specific dependency on third-party manufacturers for advanced process nodes.
old_text: We source certain components from a limited number of suppliers and depend on third parties for some manufacturing, assembly, testing and packaging services.
new_text: We have significant concentration of supply chain dependency on certain third-party manufacturers, particularly for advanced process nodes used in high-performance and AI products.

summary: AMD adds explicit AI accelerator export-control risk in the newer filing.
new_text: Government export restrictions on advanced AI accelerators may limit our ability to sell certain products into restricted markets and could affect future revenue opportunities.
